gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement (p4) prints one row 'Transfers in (out), net': General Fund 1,567,330, Community Betterment Fund (755,000), Debt Service Fund (534,330), Total 278,000; the statement JSON uses the Total-column net 278,000 (other side: Waste Water Fund Transfers Out (278,000), p8). detail[] records transfers gross: ins General Fund 'Transfers in, net' 1,567,330 (budget schedule p5, same as GAAP column) + LB840 Funds 'Transfers' 750,000 (p10) = 2,317,330. 1,567,330 - 755,000 - 534,330 = 278,000 = printed net, so 1,289,330 of the gap is the gross-vs-net basis. The other 750,000 is the LB840 Funds supplementary schedule transfer (p10), which sits inside the General Fund GAAP column (LB840 has no column on p4) and is not part of the printed statement row; it is a printed schedule line, so it stays. 278,000 + 1,289,330 + 750,000 = 2,317,330. The Debt Service Fund (534,330) is not in detail[] and is added in the 'other financing' entry below (a transfer out, so it does not change this total).

Proprietary fund statement of revenues, expenses and changes in fund net position (p8) prints one column, Waste Water Fund; no business-type lines in detail[]. Statement receipts[] = Charges for services 12,210,931 + Insurance reimbursement 18,138 + Government grants 156 + Interest income 149,439 = 12,378,664 = statement total.
